cases.name: Monica L. Will
cases.about:
“She was an English teacher and taught some elective classes like Mythology. She was just a really, really intelligent lady and taught a lot of the children,” said Marshall County Superintendent of Schools Dr. Shelby Haynes. Will hosted a close knit group of students in the card club, which met during activity period and lunchtime. The group collectively made cards for those who might need some cheering up or congratulating.

“She did have a group. She had a card club who would come to her room and eat lunch and then they would make cards for people and do some activities like that. She was just a very caring individual,” she said.
cases.narrative: He came onto the porch and shot her through a window before kicking in the door and entering the residence and shooting and killing her husband. He took their daughter hostage at gunpoint and police shot and killed him.
